reviews.comment: Satterfield had a very interesting lecture! Tests were hard so be prepare to study because he is a tough grader! But not impossible to do well in the class if you just study and read and go over the lecture notes!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Satterfield is one of those profs that you either like him or you don't. I happened to enjoy his class and labs. He does pop quizzes at the end of lecture sometimes and attendance is mandatory in lab. You do a lot of hands-on activities during labs but the lab quizzes can be tricky. This class isn't an easy A but it's very interesting and doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Worst Professor ever. Don't know how 70% of students would take him again. DO NOT TAKE! You will only regret having him "teach" you. I had to teach myself everything. he speaks super fast and note taking took forever

This is one of the worst professors I have had at A&M. He does not respect his students at all. He posts quizzes to eCampus without any notice so you have to constantly look for them. When I asked him if he could make a schedule with the due dates, he told me no and to put "check ecampus" on my calendar everyday. Don't take if you don't have to.

This class was asynchronous this semester, so it gave a little bit of wiggle room for lectures. He had quizzes due for most lectures though, so you still had to do stuff on time. Lab was easy as long as you watched the videos and read the lab book. BIG TIP: For exams, do not reference the textbook for the open answer. Just stick to the lecture.

Taking this course online, but not as bad as some of the reviews I've read. All his lectures were recorded so it was easy to print out the powerpoints and follow along with the lectures. His exams are tricky so you really need to take time to study and understand the concepts. Overall good professor, makes you work for your grade.

Dr. Satterfield is a very nice professor and is always willing to help you out. Take good notes and record the lectures as he does not provide slides with words. He will just put pictures (from the textbook) on the slides. Exams are short answer or fill in the blank, with maybe a few multiple-choice or true/false.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Record his lectures! He talks very fast, so it very easy to miss important information. Write down notes during your free time with the recordings and study that. Always made an 87 or above on his exams because of this. As for lab, study at least the day before for the weekly quizzes as these can boost your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Satterfield is a great professor! Yes his class is incredibly hard, but not impossible. STUDY!STUDY!STUDY! You earn your grade! Record his lectures because he talks really fast in class and prepare for lab quizzes. You don't want to lose lab points, thats the difference between an A and a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Satterfields class is extremely difficult. As an honors student I am struggling. I attend every class and take good notes but I still struggle. He doesnt seem to care much about your grade and he prides himself on being the most difficult ANSC class. Beware.

Repro is definitely not easy. But if you go to class, take notes and READ the book to get a BETTER understanding of your notes, you should pass! Make sure you do good in lab quizzes which aren't that hard. Every point matters! Be specific on exams because one wrong word and you get points off. I love this class. Don't procrastinate and you're good
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: test are very hard. Be very specific and too the point. Gives unexpected pop quizzes (10 total), 4 lecture exams, final. Very tough class. Make sure to do well in lab! those points will add up. Make sure to see your exam after he grades, he does not give them back out. Be prepared to study.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Repro is not an easy class, and you have to work for it, but Dr. Satterfield is a great prof. IMO, he explains the material, which can be complicated, really well and in a way that makes sense. His lectures are great, he ties in real-world applications or funny anecdotes when possible, and bonus: no trouble hearing him! Would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures
